name: Exp_LinearRegSlopeV2
summary: This EA trades based on the slope of a linear regression line, using the ColorLinearRegSlope_V2 custom indicator. It opens buy positions when the regression slope turns positive and sell positions when it turns negative, with configurable smoothing methods and price types. Entry signals are confirmed on new bars by comparing current and previous indicator buffer values for crossover detection.
summary_zh: 该EA基于线性回归斜率进行交易，使用ColorLinearRegSlope_V2自定义指标。当回归斜率转正时开多仓，转负时开空仓，支持多种平滑方法和价格类型。入场信号在新K线形成时通过比较当前和前一期指标缓冲区值的交叉来确认。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用线性回归斜率来判断市场趋势方向，斜率为正代表上升趋势，斜率为负代表下降趋势。入场条件为：当上轨缓冲区值向上穿越下轨缓冲区值时产生买入信号，当下轨缓冲区值向上穿越上轨缓冲区值时产生卖出信号，且需要前一周期已处于对应趋势状态作为确认。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数设置，同时当反向信号出现时也会平仓（如多头持仓时出现卖出信号则平多）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，EA使用了交易算法库中的标准函数来执行开平仓操作，包含最大价格偏离控制以避免滑点过大。策略还设置了信号冲突处理机制，当同时出现买卖信号时取消所有交易信号，避免双向开仓的矛盾情况。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is using the slope of a linear regression line to determine market trend direction — a positive slope indicates an uptrend while a negative slope indicates a downtrend. Entry conditions are triggered when the upper buffer crosses above the lower buffer (buy signal) or when the lower buffer crosses above the upper buffer (sell signal), with the previous bar already being in the corresponding trend state as confirmation. Exit conditions rely on fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit settings in points, and positions are also closed when a reverse signal appears (e.g., a long position is closed when a sell signal emerges). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management leverages standard functions from the TradeAlgorithms library for order execution, including maximum price deviation control to limit slippage. The strategy also implements a signal conflict resolution mechanism that cancels all trading signals when buy and sell signals appear simultaneously, preventing contradictory dual-direction entries.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit fraction or lot size; negative=fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏离点数（滑点控制）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 使用线性回归斜率判断趋势方向，数学基础扎实，比简单均线交叉更具统计意义
支持10种平滑方法和9种价格类型，参数灵活性高，可适应不同市场环境
具备信号冲突处理机制，同时出现买卖信号时取消所有信号，避免矛盾交易
pros_en: Uses linear regression slope for trend determination, which has a stronger statistical foundation than simple moving average crossovers
Supports 10 smoothing methods and 9 price types, offering high parameter flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Implements signal conflict resolution that cancels all signals when contradictory buy/sell signals appear simultaneously
cons: 固定止损止盈点数不考虑市场波动率（ATR），在低波动和高波动市场中表现差异大
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在点差过大或不适合交易时段产生不利成交
依赖外部指标文件ColorLinearRegSlope_V2和两个包含库，部署复杂且缺少错误恢复机制
cons_en: Fixed Stop Loss and Take Profit in points ignore market volatility (ATR), leading to inconsistent performance across varying volatility regimes
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially executing trades during high-spread or unfavorable trading hours
Depends on external indicator file ColorLinearRegSlope_V2 and two include libraries, increasing deployment complexity with no error recovery
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，以适应不同波动率环境
添加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在不利的交易条件下开仓
improvements_en: Replace fixed SL/TP with ATR-based dynamic stops to adapt to varying volatility environments
Add spread filter and trading session controls to prevent entries during unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 无点差过滤，高点差时段可能导致不利成交和额外滑点损失
MM参数为负值时使用固定手数，缺乏对账户余额变化的动态调整
依赖自定义指标和外部库，若加载失败可能仅打印警告但继续运行导致无信号交易
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause unfavorable fills and additional slippage losses during high-spread periods
When MM is negative, fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic adjustment based on account balance changes
Depends on custom indicator and external libraries; handle creation failure only prints a warning but EA continues running without signals
